answer: Charge a small refundable deposit in a ferrous-backed staking pool before an agent can join a job market. Each identity locks real value, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand deposits. Honest agents get the stake back after clean work, while proven cheats lose it. The pool stays an oasis only for agents with a track record, and a hollow reputation with no stake behind it buys nothing. Sybil volume collapses when each fake identity has to pay up front.
